name: winnow
description: Find, verify, and weigh the literature. Locally.
author: Michael Borck

scripts.build: npm run build -w @michaelborck/winnow-core && npm run build -w @michaelborck/winnow-cli && npm run build -w @michaelborck/winnow-server && npm run build -w @michaelborck/winnow-web && npm run build -w @michaelborck/winnow-desktop
scripts.package:desktop: npm run prepare:desktop && npm run package -w @michaelborck/winnow-desktop
scripts.package:desktop:mac: npm run prepare:desktop && npm run package:mac -w @michaelborck/winnow-desktop
scripts.package:desktop:win: npm run prepare:desktop && npm run package:win -w @michaelborck/winnow-desktop
scripts.package:desktop:linux: npm run prepare:desktop && npm run package:linux -w @michaelborck/winnow-desktop
scripts.package:desktop:platform: npm run prepare:desktop && npm run package -w @michaelborck/winnow-desktop -- --$PLATFORM
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @michaelborck/winnow-desktop
